name: executor
description: Operate authorized workstations through Executor and a Executor-pinned Desktop Commander payload.

interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT and Codex to the Executor remote MCP service, which routes authenticated requests to Executor-pinned Desktop Commander payloads on explicitly selected workstations.
capabilities: Inspect and edit authorized workstation files
Run and interact with workstation processes
Route work to an explicitly selected connected workstation
Preserve Executor effect disposition and connection-generation safety
defaultPrompt: Use Executor to inspect the connected workstation and continue the active work.
Run the requested command through Executor and verify the observed result.
Use the smallest authorized workstation effect and verify mutations by readback.
